info.description: Contains a list of all available (configured) endpoints. To test the endpoints you can use the login service to get request a bearer token. With [Try it out] you can call the service directly. Use the received JWT token to set the authentication [Authorize]. For communication with the API you need either an API key or a username and password which you will receive from the administrator.

organizationNumber.description: Default value 0 will use the first organization the user is connected to as login organization.
